narration: Mini-Kuzai V80 tested whether the five context-order changes found in V79 were only fragile numerical flips near the residual decision boundary. The V79 result replayed exactly across 9,170 validation prefixes, with five prediction changes, five alpha-sign changes, and 2,594 correct positions in both original and reversed context order. None of the changed positions fell within the widest frozen boundary threshold of one times ten to the minus three. The measured distances were clearly larger than a near-zero numerical flip. V80 therefore strengthens evidence for real context-order sensitivity, while making no claim of semantic competence or reasoning.
